security_audit.summary: Most static external-command alerts are false positives caused by Markdown code fences and inline code spans. The skill intentionally grants Bash(infsh *) and sends prompts or media URLs through inference.sh. No prompt injection or credential exfiltration language was found.

remediation.suggestion: Warn users that prompts, images, audio, and videos may be sent to inference.sh and model providers.
Move npx installation examples to documentation links or require explicit confirmation before any install action.
Bundle the image locally or remove it to avoid third-party asset requests during rendering.

content.value_statement: AI video workflows require careful model and option choices. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code run inference.sh video models for generation, avatars, lipsync, and utilities.
actual_capabilities: Lists models for text-to-video, image-to-video, avatars, lipsync, foley, upscaling, and merging.
Provides inference.sh CLI examples for Google Veo, Grok, Wan, Seedance, OmniHuman, Fabric, and PixVerse.
Shows input fields for prompts, durations, media URLs, audio URLs, transitions, and utility settings.
Guides users to browse available video apps with the inference.sh CLI.
Suggests related skills for broader media workflows.
limitations: Requires the inference.sh CLI and an authenticated account.
Media quality, speed, price, and availability depend on external model providers.
Prompts and media URLs may be sent to external services.
It does not include local video generation or editing code.

use_cases.title: Create Short Social Videos
use_cases.description: Draft short clips for posts, reels, and ads while choosing fast models for iteration.

use_cases.title: Plan Marketing Video Assets
use_cases.description: Compare video models for product demos, explainers, campaign clips, and visual experiments.

use_cases.title: Prototype Media Pipelines
use_cases.description: Combine generation, upscaling, foley, lipsync, and merging steps for repeatable video workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Simple Video
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me create a simple AI video. Ask for the subject, style, duration, aspect ratio, and target platform. Recommend one model before running anything.

prompt_templates.title: Animate an Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn this approved image URL into a short video: [URL]. Ask for motion, mood, duration, and platform. Confirm consent before using inference.sh.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Campaign Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a complete video pipeline for [campaign]. Include model choices for image-to-video, sound effects, upscaling, and final merging. Ask before each paid run.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Model Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare three model options for [goal] by speed, quality, audio support, cost risk, and input requirements. Recommend a draft path and final path.

output_examples.input: Create a five-second product teaser for a new desk lamp.
output: Suggested a fast draft model for social review.
Asked for aspect ratio, product style, and brand tone.
Prepared a concise prompt and confirmation step before running the job.

output_examples.input: Animate a portrait with voice narration.
output: Recommended an avatar or lipsync model based on the media type.
Warned that face and voice consent is required.
Requested approved media URLs before using the CLI.
Chose upscaling or foley utilities based on the request.
Planned separate enhancement steps to reduce cost and failed reruns.

best_practices: Confirm rights and consent for faces, voices, audio, and source media before avatar or lipsync work.
Use non-sensitive media URLs unless the account and provider policy allow confidential data.
Start with fast models for drafts, then switch to higher-quality models for final renders.
anti_patterns: Running video jobs with private customer images or voices without consent.
Using placeholder URLs instead of accessible media files.
Installing related skills or tools during a video task without explicit approval.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It guides AI video generation and utility jobs through the inference.sh CLI.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: It supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Do I need an account?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill requires the inference.sh CLI and login before running jobs.

faq.question: Can it use my images or audio?
faq.answer: Yes, when you provide approved media URLs. Do not use private or unlicensed media without permission.

faq.question: Can it create avatar or lipsync videos?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes examples for OmniHuman, Fabric, and PixVerse lipsync workflows.

faq.question: What should I review before running it?
faq.answer: Review media rights, prompt sensitivity, model cost, and the exact command before any job starts.
